mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 86 degrees. The moon is in its third quarter phase, and the overnight low will drop to 71 degrees with rain predicted for tonight. If you are a night owl, you can catch the ISS orbiting overhead tomorrow morning at 4:24 AM, appearing near Cross Plains and traveling toward Oregon.

City construction updates for the week of September 7 include the start of phase two for the Aldi development and Hwy M roadwork. Traffic will shift south into the eastbound lanes with one lane maintained in each direction. Also, the Military Ridge State Trail paving project is moving forward, with bridge construction beginning this month and closures scheduled between Lincoln and South Franklin Street.

There is plenty to do in town. We have live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company happening today. Looking ahead, tomorrow you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol Square or catch live music at Paddy Mac's.
In a report from August 28, officers were called to South Nine Mound Road near Paoli Street after a motor vehicle collided with a parked car. The driver was cited for inattentive driving.
Today's flavor of the day is the rich Chocolate Volcano. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:30 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
